{{Top|leg}}
A '''wind brigand''' was a type of [[wind rider]] employed by the [[Sevari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]]. They were generally armed with [[Catapult/Legends|catapults]] capable of launching glasslike spheres that exploded upon impact.
